clue.text: Duck or fish served in a vegetable container

indicators.note: food served in a dish sits inside it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a pod is the case that holds peas or beans
char is a trout-like freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A diner is offered a choice of duck or fish presented in a hollowed-out vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: The pochard is a species of diving duck.

clue.text: Stops to stretch and have a little drink

parts.note: to pull a muscle is to stretch it
to sup is to sip or drink in small amounts

explanation.surface: A traveller halts to stretch the legs and have a small drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulls up means stops, as a driver brings a vehicle to a halt.

clue.text: Up-to-date general

explanation.definitionFit: Current means both of the present time and generally prevailing.

clue.text: A number tip better

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a number
an end is a tip

explanation.surface: A count is given of a tip that is improved upon.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend is to improve or better something.

clue.text: Wanted to imbibe pop — lost all hope of it

indicators.note: to imbibe is to drink in, so the wanted word takes in the pop word

parts.note: desired means wanted
pop is a familiar word for father, pa

explanation.surface: Someone longed for a fizzy drink and gave up hope of getting it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pop' is father, not a drink. 'of it' is a link: despaired of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Despaired means gave up all hope.

clue.text: See gunmen about in the distance and wonder

indicators.note: the gunmen and the 'about' letter sit in the distance word

parts.note: a mile is a distance
RA is the Royal Artillery, the army's gunners
C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Someone spots armed men in the far distance and is amazed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' is only a link word inviting you to look. RA for the Royal Artillery is a standard crossword convention for gunners.
explanation.definitionFit: A miracle is a marvel, something that causes wonder.

clue.text: In the middle of making a film about small daughter

indicators.note: about means going round, so the film word surrounds the daughter letter

parts.note: a mist is a thin film or haze
D is the abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A filmmaker is busy shooting a picture about a young daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the middle of' reads as the definition, but MIDST alone means middle; 'In the' and 'of' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: The midst is the middle or central part of something.

clue.text: Left 12 across upset and indignant

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters fall into a new order

parts.note: the answer to 12 across, the patient assistant

explanation.surface: A nurse abandoned and distressed feels resentful.
explanation.definitionFit: Resentful means feeling bitter indignation at unfair treatment.

clue.text: Being in credit, the French are less encumbered

indicators.note: the French words are put in the credit abbreviation

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: Being in the black, the French are freer of burdens.
explanation.definitionFit: Clearer means freer of obstruction, less encumbered.

clue.text: Out-and-out maximum

explanation.definitionFit: Extreme means both utter and at the farthest limit.

clue.text: Generous donations obtained by great craft

parts.note: great means large
SS is a steamship, a seagoing craft

explanation.surface: Lavish gifts are said to have come from a large ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Largess is generosity, especially gifts given freely to many.

clue.text: Leave to assimilate second course

indicators.note: to assimilate is to take in, so the leave word takes in the second piece

parts.note: to desert is to leave

explanation.surface: An order to leave so that a second course can be absorbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Dessert is the sweet course of a meal.

clue.text: Breaking dates hastily, being really single-minded

indicators.note: breaking the word dates shatters it so its letters re-form

parts.note: fast means hastily

explanation.surface: Someone determinedly cancels appointments in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Breaking' looks like part of the surface story about cancelling dates, but it signals the rearrangement of the five letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Steadfast means resolutely firm and unwavering, wholly single-minded.

clue.text: A patient assistant

parts.note: read as someone who helps a patient in hospital, not someone who helps with patience

explanation.definitionFit: A nurse is a carer who assists people who are ill in hospital.

clue.text: Cooked food for a non-drinker in compensation

indicators.note: the non-drinker's letters are placed in the compensation word

parts.note: pay is compensation for work
TT means teetotal, a non-drinker

explanation.surface: Someone who does not drink is paid in food instead.
explanation.definitionFit: A patty is a small flat cake of cooked minced food.

clue.text: The standard certain policemen set

parts.note: the Yard is Scotland Yard, London's Metropolitan Police
to stick is to set or fix firmly

explanation.surface: Particular police officers lay down the norm.
explanation.definitionFit: A yardstick is a standard used for comparison.

clue.text: Support control with vigour

parts.note: to rein is to control
force means vigour or energy

explanation.surface: Advice to back up a regime with vigorous control.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinforce is to strengthen or support.

clue.text: Can't be taken in? There's no answer to that!

definitions.meaning: unable to be dissolved, taken in by a liquid

explanation.definitionFit: Insoluble describes both a substance that will not dissolve and a problem without a solution.

clue.text: Orders put out for projects

indicators.note: out signals the letters of orders and put are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: Instructions are issued for various planned schemes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put out' is not a phrase here: PUT is fodder with ORDERS, and 'out' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Projects as a verb means sticks out, the same as protrudes.

clue.text: Professing to be religious, the heartless may go in. It's deplorable

indicators.note: the trimmed word is to go in the religious word

parts.note: pious means devout, professing religion

indicators.note: heartless removes the middle letter of the word the

explanation.surface: Sanctimonious types without compassion may enter; it is shameful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' means losing the central letter, and 'may go in' tells the trimmed piece to sit inside the devout word.
explanation.definitionFit: Piteous means pitiful or deplorable.

clue.text: Last longer in the main without wearying

indicators.note: in signals the answer is tucked in the words without wearying

explanation.surface: Something endures in general without tiring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is part of the link phrase 'in the main', meaning generally; the letters sit in 'witHOUT WEARying'.
explanation.definitionFit: To outwear is to last longer than something else.

clue.text: Meadow Way would appear the shortest

parts.note: a lea is a meadow
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Meadow Way is supposedly the shortest road on the map.
explanation.definitionFit: The least means the smallest or shortest amount.

clue.text: Permanent dwelling

explanation.definitionFit: Abiding means both enduring and residing somewhere.

clue.text: Where ramblers could well gain support

definitions.text: Where ramblers could well gain support

parts.words: Where ramblers could well gain support
parts.note: ramblers here are rambling roses, climbing plants that need a frame, not walkers

explanation.definitionFit: A trellis is a lattice frame that supports climbing plants.

clue.text: An emperor's birds without superior

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the birds go round the superior letter

parts.note: tits are small songbirds
U means upper-class or superior

explanation.surface: An emperor keeps birds that lack anything better.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, not lacking. Titus was a Roman emperor.
explanation.definitionFit: Titus was a Roman emperor of the first century.

clue.text: Game, so came down river

parts.note: lit means landed or came down, as a bird alights
the Aire is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Someone recounts a game in which they descended a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Solitaire is a game for one player, with cards or pegs.

clue.text: A rug's maybe offered — how sweet!

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters of a rug's could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: A rug is offered as a gift, and someone exclaims at the kindness.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive 's gives an S here, part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar is what makes things sweet, and an exclamation of delight.

clue.text: Sense discrimination

explanation.definitionFit: Taste is both a bodily sense and refined judgment.

clue.text: Initiating a breach

explanation.definitionFit: Opening is both the act of starting something and a gap or hole.

clue.text: Using a belt is quite inhuman

indicators.note: the letters of a belt is are put to use in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Beating someone with a belt is described as cruel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Using' rearranges A BELT IS; the 'is' is fodder, not a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Bestial means brutal or beastlike, quite lacking humanity.

clue.text: He won't do anything, but he'll make a hit!

definitions.meaning: a worker who refuses to work
one who strikes, such as a footballer scoring or a batsman

explanation.definitionFit: A striker is both a worker on strike and one who hits.

clue.text: Pours out Oriental blends

parts.note: E stands for east, the Oriental direction
merges means blends

explanation.surface: A server pours out mixtures of Eastern tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Emerges means comes or pours out.
